$comment: Controls first numbered on P006. Ids are permanent; written by node scripts/clubhouse/clickable-map.mjs --assign. label, labelTemplate and description are yours to edit; the rest is derived from the code.

controls.description: "{main}{ {year}|}. Jump to a date" button: runs setJump

controls.label: Add to calendar app

controls.description: Drags the bottom edge of the event being adjusted on the day timeline to change its end (pointer only; the keyboard path is Alt+Shift)

controls.description: Drags the top edge of an event block in the week grid to change its start (pointer only)

controls.description: Drags the bottom edge of an event block in the week grid to change its end (pointer only)
"{dowOf} {dayNum} {monthName}{, today|}. Open the day" button: runs onDay

controls.description: Drags the start of a multi-day event bar in the month grid (pointer only)
